business_problem: InMorphis wanted to scale development, internal support, and sales-response work without depending only on scarce ServiceNow specialists or slowing teams with manual document search, repetitive code tasks, and inconsistent RFP drafting.
solution_summary: InMorphis built three internal generative-AI workflows on ServiceNow AI Agents in just four weeks. For development, the company integrated a Microsoft Teams bot with ServiceNow large language models so employees across the business could generate ServiceNow code and configurations directly from chat, extending low-friction development beyond the core engineering team. For employee operations, InMorphis created an HR and IT support bot that reads a centralized knowledge base of documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs, then returns natural-language answers in real time. For go-to-market work, the sales team uses AI Agents to analyze customer RFPs, generate draft responses, ask probing follow-up questions, and search sales collateral inside Teams. Together, those flows let one ServiceNow-centered AI fabric serve internal support, developer productivity, and revenue workflows from the same knowledge and agent foundation.

data_flow: Employees and sales staff start in Microsoft Teams, where AI workflows call ServiceNow LLMs or AI Agents depending on the task. Code-generation prompts return ServiceNow development output, while HR, IT, and RFP requests pull from the centralized knowledge base to answer questions or assemble draft responses in real time.
business_outcome: InMorphis launched three generative-AI solutions in four weeks, achieved 73% code accuracy, met 100% of IT and HR SLAs with its support bot, and improved sales-team productivity by 2.5x through AI-assisted RFP and document workflows.
